scope: Static manufacturer source contract for the UART controller used by original ESP firmware. This is not a measured clock, exact firmware rebuild or completed ASIC line model.

factory_observation.limitation: Version text joins the candidate source version, not an exact rebuild identity.

clock_selection.source_frequency: Must be supplied by modeled clock tree; not unconditionally40MHz.

predivider.fractional_fields: A bits11:6 and B bits5:0. Not configured by selected HAL baud setter; remain unsupported if nonzero until TRM semantics are established.

baud_divider.zero_divisor: Must not manufacture a fallback rate.

contract.selection_default: uart_param_config uses UART_SCLK_DEFAULT for source_clk0; ESP32-S3 defines defaultAPB. Archived miner serial.c omits source_clk. Actual guest registers still need capture.

source_clock_controls.scope: CLK_CONF fields. Proper FIFO/IRQ/reset effects require implementation and execution tests.

contract.tx_completion: Archived SERIAL_set_baud calls uart_wait_tx_done before uart_set_baudrate with a1000ms deadline; preserve ordinary bus deadline.

next_implementation: Capture actual CLK_CONF, CLKDIV and format writes with QEMU virtual timestamps for the selected original run.
Replace the S3 fixed40MHz assumption with its selected modeled clock source and predivider, preserving existing UART FIFO/IRQ infrastructure.
Schedule TX/RX character completion with virtual time. Keep bus time independent of functional hash cap.
Make clock gating/reset, buffered writes, baud transitions and framing errors real state. Validate with isolated register/transport tests and original firmware execution.
Keep the ASIC programmed request distinct from effective communication state; do not silently accept baud mismatches or fabricate replies.
not_done: No code from downloaded source executed.
No physical timing calibration or complete board pass.
